title: Mmm What are the skills you have
summary: In this conversation, the user and the AI companion discussed the AI's capabilities, organized and navigated through various browser tabs and window layouts using keyboard shortcuts and mouse movements, and attempted to locate specific screen elements and check system stats like CPU temperatures and connected ADB devices. Together, they successfully managed window snapping, fixed a PyAutoGUI fail-safe cursor error by attempting to refresh the desktop agent connection, and tried clicking on tabs and locating buttons. However, tasks like finding a specific blue "Accept all" button, retrieving CPU/GPU temperatures, running an ADB check script, and switching back to the first tab encountered errors or limitations. Left unfinished are troubleshooting the desktop control agent connection after its refresh, successfully switching to the first tab, and checking the connected ADB device, which should be picked up next time.
